newsitem.title: USA: ConEd blames NY power dip on substation fire.
newsitem.headline: ConEd blames NY power dip on substation fire.

text.p: Consolidated Edison of New York Inc said a major power dip early Wednesday in New York city was likely linked to a fire at one of its substations in nearby Yonkers, N.Y.
"We did have a power dip system-wide which affected not only New York City but Westchester county as well. All of our customers felt the dip," said company spokesman Mike Spall.
"We believe the cause is related to a fire in our Sprainbrook substation, which is located in Yonkers. The fire department is at the scene. I don't know extent of fire at this point," he said.
The power system serving the area is being restored by delivering electricity via alternative routes, he added.
ConEd serves about 3.1 million customers in New York City and Westchester County.
